verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's official MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp lets an agent read and change the Model, including Pages, Table blocks, Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables and Dimensions. Agents can also delegate to Ari through `edit_chats`/`inspect_chats`, which reaches chat-driven actions such as syncs and scenarios. However, there is no conventional API: no OpenAPI spec was found, no API keys are issued, and every client must sign in as a person via OAuth. Nothing claims full UI parity. missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity statement, a documented general-purpose REST API or OpenAPI spec, programmatic coverage of sharing read-only links, Excel export and connection setup, and independent hands-on corroboration.
